title: Positive Testing: LTE Single UE Attach and Detach Procedure Validation
description: Validate the successful attach and detach procedure of a single UE on an LTE cell under excellent radio conditions for 10 iterations.
preconditions: Single LTE cell activated and unloaded; all other cells powered off
UE (real or emulated) placed under excellent LTE radio conditions (RSRP as per Clause 4.6)
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure the test setup according to the test configuration and activate the LTE serving cell
Place the UE under excellent radio conditions (cell center near radiated eNB antenna)
Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure
Wait for successful attach confirmation (attach request and attach complete messages)
Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated LTE detach procedure
Wait for successful detach confirmation (detach request and detach accept messages)
Stop and save the logs
Repeat steps 3 to 8 for a total of 10 iterations
Measure and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency (min, average, max)
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rate is 100% across 10 iterations
Attach latency values correctly captured and within expected thresholds
UE is attached to correct LTE cell (validate PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN)
Signaling connection release confirmed by UE context release and RRC connection release messages
postconditions: Logs saved for test result reference
Test report includes KPI tables 5-2 and 5-3 with measured values
verificationMethods: Log analysis of attach request and attach complete messages
Log analysis of detach request and detach accept messages
Verification of radio parameters (RSRP) to ensure excellent radio conditions
Validation of UE cell attachment parameters from UE logs

title: Positive Testing: 5G NSA Single UE Attach and Detach with Secondary Node Addition and Release
description: Validate the successful attach and detach procedures including Secondary Node Addition and Release for a single UE in 5G NSA mode under excellent radio conditions over 10 iterations.
preconditions: Single LTE cell with 5G NSA enabled activated and unloaded; all other cells powered off
UE (real or emulated) placed under excellent 5G SS-RSRP radio conditions (Clause 4.6)
Test configuration parameters recorded
testSteps: Configure test setup for 5G NSA according to test configuration
Place the UE at cell center near radiated eNB/gNB antenna(s)
Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure including EN-DC Secondary Node Addition
Wait for successful attach and Secondary Node Addition confirmation (attach request, attach complete, SgNB addition request, SgNB reconfiguration complete)
Power OFF the UE to initiate UE-initiated LTE detach and 5G Secondary Node Release procedures
Wait for successful detach and Secondary Node Release confirmation (detach request, detach accept, UE context release, RRC connection release, Secondary Node Release messages)
Stop and save the logs
Repeat steps 3 to 9 for 10 iterations
Measure and record attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, and detach success rate
expectedResults: Attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, and detach success rate are 100% for 10 iterations
Secondary Node Release procedures initiated and confirmed correctly
Signaling connection release confirmed with UE context release and RRC connection release messages
UE is attached to correct LTE and NR cells (validate PCI, Global eNB ID/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN)
postconditions: Logs saved for test result reference
Test report includes KPI tables 5-2 with attach, secondary node addition, and detach success rates
verificationMethods: Log analysis for attach request, attach complete, SgNB addition request, and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages
Log analysis for detach request, detach accept, UE context release, RRC connection release, and Secondary Node Release messages
Verification of radio parameters (5G SS-RSRP) to ensure excellent radio conditions
Validation of UE cell attachment parameters from UE logs

title: Negative Testing: LTE Attach Failure Due to Poor Radio Conditions
description: Verify behavior when a single UE attempts LTE attach under poor radio conditions below minimum coupling loss.
preconditions: Single LTE cell activated
UE placed under poor LTE radio conditions below minimum coupling loss as defined in Clause 4.6
testSteps: Configure test setup with poor radio conditions using variable attenuator or fading generator
Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure
Observe attach procedure outcome
Power OFF the UE
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or times out due to poor radio conditions
Attach success rate below 100% (possibly 0%)
Appropriate error or failure messages logged
No successful attach indication in UE logs
verificationMethods: Log analysis for failure or timeout messages during attach
Verification of radio parameters to confirm poor conditions
Validation of UE logs for attach failure

title: Negative Testing: 5G NSA Secondary Node Release Rejection by SN
description: Validate behavior when Secondary Node Release request is rejected by the Secondary Node (SN) during 5G NSA detach.
preconditions: 5G NSA test setup with activated MN and SN
UE attached to 5G NSA cell with active secondary node
Test environment configured to simulate SN rejecting SN Release request
testSteps: Initiate UE-initiated detach procedure from MN side
MN sends SgNB Release Request message to SN
SN rejects SN Release request (simulate rejection condition)
Observe signaling flow and error handling
Verify if MN handles rejection gracefully (e.g., retries, cancels, or logs error)
Power OFF UE to complete detach procedure
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: SN rejection of SN Release request is correctly handled by MN
Signaling messages indicate rejection and appropriate error handling
UE detach procedure completes without unexpected failures
Logs capture rejection and subsequent signaling
postconditions: Logs saved for error handling analysis
verificationMethods: Log analysis of SgNB Release Request and Release Request Acknowledge messages
Verification of MN handling of rejection
Validation of UE detach completion

title: Edge Case Testing: LTE Attach Latency Measurement at Boundary Radio Conditions
description: Measure LTE attach latency at the edge of excellent radio conditions and just below minimum coupling loss to verify boundary behavior.
preconditions: Single LTE cell activated
UE placed at two radio conditions: at minimum coupling loss limit and just below it
testSteps: Configure test setup with radio condition at minimum coupling loss
Start logs
Power ON UE to attach; measure attach latency
Power OFF UE to detach
Repeat attach and detach for 5 iterations at this radio condition
Reconfigure radio condition to just below minimum coupling loss
Repeat attach and detach for 5 iterations
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Attach latency at minimum coupling loss is within expected limits
Attach success rate may decrease below minimum coupling loss
Latency and success rate differences between conditions are analyzed
Attach procedure may fail or delay significantly below minimum coupling loss
postconditions: Logs saved for latency and success rate comparison
verificationMethods: Latency measurement from logs (attach request to attach complete)
Attach success rate calculation
Radio parameter verification

title: Performance Testing: 5G NSA Attach and Detach Success Rate and Latency Under Continuous Load
description: Measure attach and detach success rates and latency over 10 consecutive iterations under continuous load to assess system stability and performance.
preconditions: 5G NSA test setup with single UE in excellent radio conditions
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Start logs to capture signaling and call flow
Power ON UE to initiate attach procedure
Wait for successful attach and Secondary Node Addition
Power OFF UE to initiate detach and Secondary Node Release
Wait for successful detach completion
Repeat attach-detach cycle continuously 10 times without delay
Stop and save logs
Measure KPIs: attach success rate, detach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, and attach latency
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates remain at 100% across cycles
Attach latency within acceptable performance thresholds
No degradation or failures observed due to continuous load
System remains stable and responsive
verificationMethods: Log analysis for success message sequences
Latency calculation from signaling timestamps
KPI reporting as per Table 5-2 and 5-3

title: Security Testing: 5G NSA Attach with Authentication Failure Scenario
description: Validate system behavior when authentication during 5G NSA attach fails.
preconditions: 5G NSA test setup activated
UE configured to send invalid authentication credentials or simulate authentication failure
testSteps: Start logs
Power ON UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure
Simulate authentication failure during attach (e.g., reject authentication request)
Observe system response and signaling messages
Power OFF UE
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails due to authentication failure
Appropriate failure messages are logged
UE is not attached to the network
System properly handles authentication failure without crashes or security breaches
postconditions: Logs saved for security failure analysis
verificationMethods: Log analysis of authentication messages and failure indications
Validation that UE is not attached
Security logs review

title: Integration Testing: Coordination Between MN and SN During Secondary Node Release Procedure
description: Validate the signaling coordination and data forwarding between Master Node (MN) and Secondary Node (SN) during Secondary Node Release in 5G NSA.
preconditions: 5G NSA test setup with active MN and SN
UE attached with active secondary node
Test configuration recorded
testSteps: Trigger Secondary Node Release initiated by MN
Observe MN sending SgNB Release Request and SN responding with SgNB Release Request Acknowledge
Verify MN sends RRCConnectionReconfiguration message to UE to release SCG configuration
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report to MN
Confirm data forwarding starts appropriately
MN receives UE Context Release from SN
Verify SN releases radio and control plane resources associated with UE
Repeat procedure for SN initiated Secondary Node Release
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: Signaling flow between MN and SN follows defined procedure (steps 1-9 per Clause 10.4.1)
Data forwarding and reporting messages exchanged correctly
UE receives RRC reconfiguration for SCG release
Resources released properly at SN
No signaling errors or inconsistencies
verificationMethods: Log analysis of SgNB Release Request, SgNB Release Request Acknowledge, RRCConnectionReconfiguration, SN Status Transfer, and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages
Validation of data forwarding start and resource release
Confirmation of UE reconfiguration

title: Usability Testing: Clarity and Simplicity of Test Procedure for LTE Attach-Detach
description: Evaluate the clarity, simplicity, and understandability of the LTE attach-detach test procedure documentation and steps by test engineers.
preconditions: Test engineers provided with the LTE attach-detach test procedure documentation
testSteps: Have test engineers read and follow the test procedure steps without prior explanation
Ask engineers to perform the test setup and execute the attach-detach procedure
Collect feedback on clarity, step detail sufficiency, and ease of understanding
Identify any ambiguities or missing information
Suggest improvements to procedure documentation
expectedResults: Test engineers can perform LTE attach-detach tests accurately without confusion
No significant ambiguities or missing steps identified
Feedback collected to improve documentation and usability
verificationMethods: Qualitative feedback and observation
Documentation review

title: Compatibility Testing: 5G NSA Attach and Detach Across Different UE Emulator Versions
description: Verify the 5G NSA attach-detach procedure compatibility across multiple UE emulator software versions.
preconditions: 5G NSA test setup activated
Multiple versions of UE emulator software available
testSteps: For each UE emulator version:
Configure test setup and activate 5G NSA serving cell
Place UE emulator under excellent radio conditions
Start logs
Power ON UE emulator to initiate attach with Secondary Node Addition
Wait for successful attach and secondary node addition
Power OFF UE emulator to initiate detach and Secondary Node Release
Wait for successful detach
Stop and save logs
Record attach/detach success rates and latencies
Compare results across versions
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100% across UE emulator versions
Attach latency within acceptable range for all versions
No version-related compatibility issues
Signaling messages conform to specifications
verificationMethods: Log analysis for attach/detach success and latency
Cross-version KPI comparison

title: 5G NSA Xn Handover Test
description: Validate Xn handover procedure including Measurement Report, Handover Required, Handover Request, Handover Request Ack, RRC Reconfiguration, Path Switch, and Handover Complete.
preconditions: 5G NSA test setup with UE attached and active
Two adjacent gNBs connected via Xn interface
testSteps: Start logs
UE sends Measurement Report indicating need for handover
Network sends Handover Required to source gNB
Source gNB sends Handover Request to target gNB
Target gNB responds with Handover Request Acknowledge
Source gNB sends RRC Reconfiguration message to UE
UE performs handover and sends Handover Complete
Network performs Path Switch procedure
Stop and save logs
expectedResults: All handover signaling messages exchanged successfully
UE successfully transitions to target gNB
Path Switch completed with appropriate data path updates
No call drops or session interruptions
Logs confirm successful handover procedure
verificationMethods: Log analysis of handover signaling messages
Validation of UE connectivity post handover
Path Switch confirmation in core network logs
